blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Sandiganbayan noted that the Commission on Audit (COA) found the anti-graft court compliant with the state auditors’ accounting policies. The anti-graft court issued the statement on Thursday after media reports said COA had flagged the court over insufficient documentation for the foreign travels undertaken by some of its officials and employees. In its 2025 audit report, COA noted that the Sandiganbayan received P11.87 million in cash advances for foreign travel by its officials and employees during the year.
